step1_analysis.description: A synchronized switch driver or dynamic latch used in current-steering DACs. It features a clocked pseudo-differential input pair and a cross-coupled NMOS load that acts as a swing-limiting clamp to adjust the crossing point and increase switching speed.

paper_reference.title: A 10-bit 1-GSample/s Nyquist Current-Steering CMOS D/A Converter

paper_reported.value: 61 dB (Note: likely refers to DAC SFDR, but gain is measured here)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm ~ 1mS (at 200uA bias). Rload = 5k (added for testability). Gain = gm * Rload = 5 V/V = 14 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the gm of the input pair and the 5k pull-up resistors added to establish a DC operating point.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). Rload = 5k, Cload ~ 20fF -> BW ~ 1.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the RC time constant of the output nodes with the added 5k load and parasitic capacitances.

power_dc.description: DC power consumption when CLK is high

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ~ 200uA per branch. Total current ~ 400uA. Power = 1.8V * 400uA = 0.72 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the saturation current of the input pair with 0.9V DC bias.

v_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing during switching

sky130_expected.calculation: Max voltage is 1.8V. Min voltage is clamped by the cross-coupled NMOS (XM5/XM6) turning on when V(N4)-V(N3) > Vth. Clamps at ~0.5V. Swing = 1.8 - 0.5 = 1.3V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cross-coupled NMOS transistors act as active clamps, preventing the output from fully discharging to 0V.

t_delay.description: Propagation delay from CLK rise to output fall

sky130_expected.calculation: I_discharge ~ 1mA, C ~ 20fF. dV/dt = 50 V/ns. Time to drop 0.9V is ~18ps + intrinsic delay ~ 40ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High-speed switch drivers are designed for minimal delay to support 1 GS/s operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, transient voltage swing, and propagation delay of the clocked switch driver.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Clocked Switch Driver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N3 INP N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 INN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VDD N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VDD N3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Pull-up resistors added to provide DC path and baseline swing
R1 N3 VDD 5k
R2 N4 VDD 5k

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(1.8 0 0 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VCLK CLK 0 DC 1.8 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 0.4n 1n)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power_dc

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(N3)
  meas ac max_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 3n
  meas tran v_max max v(N3)
  meas tran v_min min v(N3)
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing
  
  meas tran t_delay trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=3n
  let dyn_power = -avg_current * 1.8
  print dyn_power
  
  quit
.endc
.end
